## Findings ledger
- [D3.DOC1.F8] The text applies the concept of technique to a possible post-revolutionary society by treating conscious technological transformation and worker control as conditions for changing the work process — dim: method_and_evidence — term: technique — move: application — evidence: political projection grounded in analysis of work and production — anchor: "a conscious transform-ation of technology, aiming to turn the work process from a mutilation of men into a field for the free exercise of the creativity of individuals and groups" — doc: technique — confidence: high

sections_inspected: Opening discussion of language, tools and anthropology
Technique, Creation and the Constitution of the Human World
scope_outcomes.criterion: A finding must identify an actual derivation, illustration, application or assumption establishing the use of the concept, supported by a verbatim passage.
scope_outcomes.basis: The inspected source repeatedly derives, applies and assumes claims about technique through etymological analysis, philosophical interpretation, historical and anthropological examples, and analysis of social organisation, production and politics.
limitations: The assessment concerns the supplied source text and its indicated sections only.
The source includes citations and examples, but their independent evidentiary validity is not assessed here.

evidence_state.coverage_basis: reader/reviewer report; source bytes do not establish inspection or completeness
blocking_issues: One or more declared finding references lack retained verified evidence
